text: Hello everyone, nice to see you.My name is Sarah.Welcome to my class.Please get your student's book and worksheet ready.Today we are going to start unit 6.I'm going to take you to explore the unknown world to discover something new.Hope you will enjoy the adventure.Look at picture.What can you see in picture?Where are high and low?Are they on the earth?Tom, what do you think?I don't think they are on the earth.I think they are in outer space.High is wearing space suits and I can see a spaceship behind high.I guess they took a spaceship to another planet.Yes, you have an eye for detail.They are probably carrying out a space exploration.Exploration is the long form of explore, which means to search and discover about something.If we traveled to another planet today, what do you think we would find?Jerry?We would probably find oceans, rivers, mountains, deserts, plants and animals as well.I think there are definitely mountains and rocks.The Mars is the planet we humans have been studying.Its surface is very rocky with big valleys and volcanoes.What would high and low find on the planet?Let's read a dialogue between them.What can you learn from their dialogue?Anything funny?Do you think it is a safe planet?What can you see behind low?Something like a dinosaur, a very giant and strange creature.Giant means extremely large.We call a giant and strange creature a monster.Say after me.Giant, giant, monster, monster.The monster is getting nearer to low and high.We can say the monster is approaching them from behind.Approach, approach, approach, approach, approach.Now you can get the funny side of the cartoon.High thinks the planet is safe because there are no people on it and thus there is no danger.However, a monster like a dinosaur is approaching them from behind.It seems that space exploration is full of danger and unknown things.The explorers will always be ready to take adventures.Today we are going to read something about space exploration.Please open your book and turn to page 93.Quickly go through the page, read the title, the picture and the layout.What type of text do you think it is?Is it a story or an informational article?A story.You can see the word story in the introduction part.Why is the story divided into two parts?I hope you will find the answers later.What comes to your mind when you read the title and the introduction?Any questions in your mind, Lucy?Yes, I would ask, who was Gorg and who was caught by Gorg?What does Captain mean?What adventures did Captain King have?Good questions.Can you answer the questions when you see the picture?Or more questions in your mind?Daniel?I guess Gorg is a monster.He is so large and strange.He has only one eye.Captain King and his friends were caught in a cage by Gorg.I'm wondering where they were and how they were caught.Good for you.Captain King was probably caught by a monster who had a single eye.Single means only one.And remember, always engage your mind by asking and answering questions as you read.Take a close look at the picture.What else can we see?There is some huge furniture.We can see a U-shaped object above the cage.It is attracting some small items to it.Can you guess what it is?Yes, it is a magnet, 磁铁.A magnet is used to attract metal things.Say after me, magnet, magnet.Can you see the buttons on the wall?What are they for?With the questions in your mind, go into the story and find the answers.Since it is a very long story and contains many paragraphs, I suggest that you should number the paragraphs before reading through the story.Let's read paragraphs one and two of part one first.When you read, try to figure out the setting and characters.Underline them, add notes or give comments.You can read and think in this way.Then, complete task one on a worksheet.Have you finished?Who are the characters?We can read about Captain Keen and his men in the first two paragraphs.The first one is Keen.He was the captain.Now you know the exact meaning of the word captain.A captain is a person in charge of a ship or an aircraft.Captain Keen was in charge of the spaceship.The second person is Peters.He was the navigator.A navigator's job is to find a way a ship or a plane should go.Say after me, navigator, navigator.The third person is a lady, Lam.She was the pilot.Her job was to fly the spaceship.Any other members in the spaceship?Sure.Or, 12 of them makes the crew of the spaceship.Crew means 全体机组人员或船员.What was the setting of the story?When and where did the story take place?Jason?It took place in a cave of a valley on an unexplored planet when it was towards evening.Right.Towards evening on an unexplored planet.Had anyone been to the planet before?It was an unexplored one.Unexplored means not having been explored.Why did Captain Keen and his crew land on this place?They lost their way and they were running out of food.Good job.They got lost and had no food.They might want to try their luck to find some food or help on the planet.We can see mountains and valleys in it.We can also see a cliff.This high area with a very steep side is called cliff.悬崖 Now I have added something to the picture.Does the picture match the descriptions of the place they landed on?Can you spot the differences?Take a few seconds to think about it.How is it going?How many differences have you found?Yuki?I found three.The first one is the location of the spaceship.It should be close to the cliff, but in the picture, the spaceship is far from it.The second one is the cliff.According to the story, the cliff was made of smooth rock, but in the picture, it is rough.The third one is the door of the cave.The two doors should be of the same size.Excellent.Both of the doors are two stories high.Story means floor, level of a building.But I'm afraid you've missed one difference.Were both of the doors closed?One of the doors was opened a little.Then Captain Keen and his crew went through the door and entered a huge cave.What did they see in the huge cave, Cloudy?They saw furniture, similar to furniture on the earth, but it was huge.Good.The furniture was similar to that on the earth, but huge.Whose cave might it be, Victoria?I think it might belong to Gork, because Gork was a huge monster.He needed to use huge things.It makes sense.So we'll read about new characters in the story.Who were they?What would happen next?With the questions, please read paragraphs 3 to 7, find new characters.Don't forget to ask questions as you read.Okay.Who did Captain Keen and his crew see in the cave?Gork and animals like kangaroos.What was the possible relationship between the kangaroos and Gork?Peter, make a guess.They might be friends.Maybe.What do you think, Jerry?Yeah, both are possible answers.Was Gork friendly to Captain Keen and his crew?Dora?Gork roared to them and called them aliens.We see aliens in some science fiction movies.They are creatures from another world, a different world from our earth.How did Gork feel about finding aliens in his cave?For Gork, the spacemen were aliens, and he was very angry at them.What would Gork do with them?And what would happen next?Let's move on to part two.Read paragraphs 8 to 9 and answer the questions.What name did Captain Keen make up for himself?He called himself Nobody.Why did he call himself Nobody?Why didn't he use his real name?I hope later you'll find answers out.And what was the real trouble to Captain Keen and his crew?Gork planned to kill all of them the next morning.Why did Gork want to kill them all?Because they killed all the aliens in this valley.Would Captain Keen and his crew die?Kelly, what's your view?Of course not.It was Captain Keen who told us the story.I guess in the end the monsters set them free.Good guess.What do you think the next paragraph will be talking about?I think it will be talking about how Captain Keen and his crew were caught.Bingo!Now let's read paragraph 10 and put the actions in order.This is task two on a worksheet.Okay, this is the correct order.Have you got them correct?So which word has the same meaning as rose up?The word sprang.Sprang is the past form of spring.Here spring is a verb.Spring, sprang.The steel balls sprang up to make a cage.The cage was made of steel, gang, which meant it would be very strong.How did Captain Keen describe their situation in the cage?They were like rats in a trap.A trap is an instrument for catching something or someone in.For example, a cage or a hole.Now you know what the buttons were used for to control the cage and huge magnet.There the crew were trapped in the cage like rats and lost their guns.What would they do then?Wait to die?Would Captain Keen save his men or leave them behind?I think Captain would surely work out a good plan to save them all.I think so too.What would Captain Keen do to save himself and his crew?How was the name nobody going to help them escape?What else might be part of the plan?Now let's read paragraphs 11 to 16 and think about the questions.Can you find answers to the questions?Probably not.We need more clues.Let me ask you more questions.How did Peters and Lam feel about the situation they were in?Ryan?I think they were afraid and they didn't believe that Captain Keen had a good plan.Lam didn't understand why Captain Keen called himself nobody and Peter's voice was shaking with fear.How did Captain Keen feel about the situation?He was confident.He told the others just to trust him and that they would all live.But why did Captain Keen talk to Gorg in a friendly way?Because he was still hoping that Gorg wouldn't kill them if they came in peace and could make friends with Gorg.Good girl, Yuki.What was the favor Gorg would do for Captain Keen?He would kill Captain Keen last.Did Gorg really do Captain Keen a favor?Yvonne, what do you think?I don't think so.I think Gorg was a fierce monster.He wanted to kill all the people in the cave.It was not a favor at all.And you, Kelly?I don't think it was a favor.Instead, it was cruel because if Captain Keen was the last one to die, he would see his friends die in front of him.That was so terrible.Good points, both of you.You still have no idea of Captain Keen's plan, do you?Think about the things mentioned in parts one and two.What an experience Captain Keen would take with him.Why did Captain Keen call himself nobody?We'll discuss his plan in detail in the next period.So far, we've finished reading a text.Let's sum up what we have discussed.The story is divided into two parts.Think about the setting, characters, and events again.Is the story in two different places?If so, where?Are there different people in each part of the story?If so, who?Are there different actions in each part of the story?If so, what?Please complete the table.It is task three on your worksheet.Here are the possible answers for your reference.Now, with the information in the table, can you summarize the main idea of each part in your own words?Daniel, have a try.In part one, the crew left the spaceship and entered a huge cave, and found that Gorg was angry at them.In part two, the crew got caught by Gorg and planned an escape.Good summary, Daniel.In part one, the crew entered the cave and found that Gorg was very angry at them.In part two, Captain Keen tried to be friendly, but Gorg caught them and promised to kill them.How does the ending of part one make you want to read part two?How does the ending of part two make you want to read more?At the end of part one, we want to know what Gorg would do next.Would he harm the spaceman?In part two, Captain Keen didn't reveal his plan.He was confident and said, But we still don't know how he would manage the escape.We want to read more to find out his plan.The story is getting more and more complicated and exciting.We will dig deeper into the story in the next period.Here is today's homework.请同学们按照作业单中的要求完成所有的内容 This is the end of today's lesson.I'll see you next time.Bye bye.
